definitions.explanation: Earnest advice, often with a tone of caution or warning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}した→無視する：13473_mushi⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was warned by the doctor.

examples.japanese: {忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧⟦べきだ→べきだ：26592_bekida⟧。
examples.english: You should listen to the advice.

notes:
{忠告|ちゅうこく} is earnest advice given out of concern, often with a warning tone. Stronger and more serious than general advice (⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧ or ⟦アドバイス→アドバイス：10699_adobaisu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to warn, to advise earnestly
- {忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to heed advice
- {忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：13473_mushi⟧: to ignore advice/warnings
- {忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow the warning
- {忠告|ちゅうこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧: to lend an ear to advice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧: advice (neutral, helpful suggestion)
- ⟦アドバイス→アドバイス：10699_adobaisu⟧: advice (casual loanword)
- ⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧: warning (stronger, more official/threatening)
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: caution, warning (lighter than {忠告|ちゅうこく})

USAGE:
Implies the speaker genuinely cares about the listener and wants to prevent negative consequences. Often given by friends, family, or doctors.
